title: Local Minimax Constants for Threshold Modified Treatment Policies at Critical Density
banked_reason: D0.5.G: load-bearing uniform two-deficiency product-limit theorem is not proved; dependent sharp Bernoulli and causal constants are unestablished; delivered tier incremental below field floor.
proof_attempt_summary: Eight D0 solve rounds assembled a triangular Bernoulli-to-Gaussian product-limit argument, exact target geometry, finite decision programs, and proposed causal and banked-class transfers. D0.5 found that the uniform two-direction experiment limit was asserted without the required quantified likelihood, approximation, and Markov-kernel proofs; the dependent sharp conclusions therefore remain unestablished. A future attempt must prove that limit from both directions, repair the finite-program dimension and panel findings, and rerun review before using any claimed constant or transfer.
tldr: For randomized continuous assignment with density \(2a\), the lower-threshold modified-policy mean equals the observed triangular regression-substitution functional, and the onto canonical lift makes observed and causal decision problems identical on the declared critical class. The local experiment converges to an independent Gaussian location plus white noise with target \(v+c^{5/3}g(0)\). Its exact target range is \([-M_\sharp,M_\sharp]\), and its clipped-tent modulus together with the unrestricted minimax squared-risk value \(R^*\), absolute-risk value \(R_{\mathrm{abs}}^*\), and honest expected-length value \(C_\alpha^*\) are certified by convergent deterministic Gaussian programs. These programs settle the unrestricted values; finite-dimensional analytic formulas and any strict nonlinear-over-affine advantage remain open. Qualitative two-direction convergence yields local attaining Bernoulli procedures but not computable transfer kernels. The published banked comparator is the full one-stratum class of Borel densities satisfying \(c_-a\leq\pi_*(a)\leq c_+a\) almost everywhere on all of \([0,1]\); \(\bar\delta\) controls only threshold admissibility and structural-mean regularity. Canonical lifts choose \(p_*=1\) and \(\pi_*(a)=2a\) inside that class. Their ancillary singleton label transfers \(R_{\mathrm{abs}}^*\) and \(C_\alpha^*\) as lower bounds for both observed and causal banked criteria. The banked anchor supplies matching-order upper bounds, giving broad-class \(n^{-1/2}\) order but no broad sharp equality, upper-procedure transfer, or broad attaining local rule.
gap: The banked threshold-atom artifact supplies adjacent rate and phase-diagram motivation under absolute loss on a broader class; it is not a same-loss, common-class comparator, and its absolute-loss sharp-constant question remains open. Existing causal modified-policy work identifies the map under standard overlays, while existing equivalence and Gaussian decision papers do not establish this moving Bernoulli product experiment or its unrestricted constants.
fill: This project establishes a new two-direction moving-window Bernoulli product limit and derives certified unrestricted squared-risk and honest expected-length constants for its declared critical causal submodel. It also proves the onto causal bridge, the exact clipped-tent modulus, and qualitative transfer from the Gaussian experiment.
